subtitle: A moment of focus.
helpText:
Remove matching pairs. A tile is free when no tile covers it and its entire left or right side is exposed. An exposed front or back does not unlock it. Higher layers can partially cover several tiles below.

In the classic set, ordinary tiles must be identical. Any flower matches any other flower, and any season matches any other season. A flower never matches a season. Geometry and nature require an identical symbol and number.

A hint shows a legal pair, not necessarily a safe move. A solvable start does not guarantee success after arbitrary choices. The pair counter counts all combinations of two matching free tiles, not different symbols.

You have one shuffle per game, available at any time. It preserves remaining tiles, time and counters. It is only used after finding a complete solution. Resuming a save never resets the allowance. Play again begins a new game with the original arrangement and a new allowance.

Arrows: navigate tiles. Enter or Space: select. H: hint. Esc: pause. F11: full screen. Tab: buttons. Pausing hides the board and stops the clock. Returning to the menu saves your progress.

tutorialIntro: Practice on small boards. These lessons do not replace your game or record results.
lessonText0: The middle tile is blocked on both sides. Remove the two end circles first, then the triangles.
lessonText1: Covered tiles cannot be selected. Remove the upper triangles first, then the circles.
lessonText2: Different flowers match each other, as do different seasons. A flower never matches a season.
menuIntro: Find matching pairs and uncover the next layer. Settle in and play at your own pace.

backgroundIntro: Choose a table texture or bring your own photo.
